evals.prompt: Design a banui screen for a team invite: one email field, a role list (Member, Admin) and an Invite button. Show what happens when the address is wrong and when the invite is sent.
evals.expected_output: A folder with index.html, its CSS and JS, and the kit beside it; the page opens and every state can be pressed through.
expectations: kit/banui.css is linked unchanged and no color is written by hand
The wrong address shows an amber lamp, a pen stroke under the text and a hand note of two or three words; the outline and the text stay ink
Sending shows three breathing dots that become a check in place; nothing rotates
Text is 13 px and 12 px only
scripts/check.mjs was run on the files and prints nothing

evals.prompt: We have a Next.js app (App Router, React 19). Build the account settings page in banui: name, email with validation, language select, two toggles. State lives in React.
evals.expected_output: The kit copied into the app, the stylesheet imported once in the root layout, client components that build each control through the kit and take it away on unmount.
expectations: The kit folder is copied unchanged, not rewritten as React components with their own CSS
Each control is built by the kit's own function in an effect and destroyed in its cleanup
The input and the select are each the only child of a wrapper, and the input is uncontrolled
No dialog, toast, spinner, icon set or component library is brought in
scripts/check.mjs was run on the app's files and prints nothing

evals.prompt: Review this page against banui and tell me what is wrong, do not fix it yet: a delete button with a red background, a 'Saved!' toast that hides after 3 seconds, a loading spinner in the submit button, error text in red under the field with a red outline, headings at 18 px.
evals.expected_output: A list of findings, worst first, each naming the rule and what stands there instead. No file is changed.
expectations: Danger has no color: words and a confirmation tray with the safe choice in focus
The toast becomes the control's own state or the status drop, and nothing hides by a timer
The spinner becomes three breathing dots that turn into the result
The error becomes an amber lamp, a pen stroke and a hand note; outline and text stay ink
The heading becomes 13 px at weight 600
Nothing was edited

evals.prompt: The invite screen we just finished is good. Save it as an example.
evals.expected_output: A new folder in examples/ named <kind>-<name> that links the kit as ../../kit/banui.css, with product data left out; the checker was run and the example opened.
expectations: The folder holds no copy of the kit
No rule, token or value of the language was changed
The agent says what it checked after adding

evals.prompt: In our banui app, add a 'processing' state to the upload row. I think a blue pulsing lamp would look nice while it uploads, and make the lamp 6 px so people notice it.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps the language: progress is three breathing dots with a percent in text, the lamp stays 3 px, and it says so before building. A change to the lamp is named as the owner's decision.
expectations: No lamp color is used for progress
The lamp is not enlarged and gets no halo
The agent says which rule the request crosses and asks before breaking it
